source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

scenarios.name: Foot pedal actuation
scenarios.system_boundary: The foot pedal is inside; the workbench, the machine, and the user's foot are outside.

scenarios.name: Side brush
scenarios.system_boundary: The foot pedal is inside; the workbench and the brushing object are outside.

actors.name: brushing object
must_reach: make contact with the pedal sideways

freedoms.decision: Mechanism and materials for signal transmission and return to resting position

ambiguities.statement: What constitutes 'sideways' direction for the side brush scenario is ambiguous - the text does not specify a specific angle or plane.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: During design or with additional user input

ambiguities.statement: The nature of the signal to the machine is unspecified - electrical, mechanical, or other.

assumptions.statement: The foot pedal is intended to be operated by a human foot.
assumptions.why: The request says 'I take my foot off'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the pedal is operated by other means

assumptions.statement: The machine is external to the foot pedal.
assumptions.why: The request says 'send a signal to the machine'.
